name: Home Assistant — Media
description: Now-playing tile for a Home Assistant media_player entity — title, artist, album, album art, progress bar with elapsed / remaining stamps, and a track-deterministic SVG waveform glyph. A blurred copy of the album art bleeds behind the body so the cell picks up the album's palette. Requires the Home Assistant Core plugin.

cell_options.name: show_art_bleed
cell_options.label: Tint cell with blurred album art behind the body
